card.fires_on: The word "of" right after dose or component nouns such as "dose", "dosage", "coadministration" or "component", just before a drug name or amount. Also seen at a few spots inside numbers and drug names.

modes.description: The linking word "of" follows dose, dosage, coadministration or component and leads into a drug name.

card.writes: It suppresses generic drug words such as drug and medication, so it steers the next word away from them, toward a specific name or number.
card.plain: It fires on the word "of" in phrases like "recommended dosage of", where a specific drug name or amount comes next.
